hints.title: Component Boundary Transitions
hints.text: Count transitions between node values present in the subset and subsequent nodes outside the subset.

hints.title: Set Membership Check
hints.text: Store all query numbers in a lookup set for constant time presence queries during list traversal.

hints.title: Component Tail Detection
hints.text: A component terminates whenever current node value is in the set and either next node is null or next node value is absent from the set.

hints.title: See the blueprint

variables: N: number of nodes in linked list
complexity.notes: Single traversal of linked list checking set membership per node.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Searching nums linearly per node yields quadratic O(N * M) time.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Hash set stores M integers in O(M) auxiliary space.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Increment count precisely at the tail of each contiguous segment.
